digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter comment handling
propositions: DC's jira.text.field.character.limit is admin-settable (range 0-2147483647) but rebar hardcodes the comment ceiling at 32767, causing silent truncation when an administrator raises or removes the limit
Comments longer than 32767 but within the instance's configured limit are silently truncated, resulting in permanent divergence between local and remote comment bodies
sanitize_comment and fit_comment both use the description fitter, creating a structural trap where changes to description fitting logic could incorrectly retarget comment truncation
The comment ceiling must be configurable via [tool.rebar.reconciler].comment_max_chars with default 32767 and range 0-2147483647 matching jira.text.field.character.limit
Auto-discovery of the ceiling from /rest/api/2/application-properties is not viable because the endpoint requires Administer Jira permission while rebar authenticates as an ordinary user
